Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r2 --slot 1 --why "Next reachable slot separates both pairs involving candidate zero at four sigma, cheap since it skips nothing, narrows the three way tie before committing later slots to the tightest pair"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r2 --slot 31 --why "One versus two remains the only live pair with real support, slot thirty one is the earliest reachable point close to the best available separation for a confirmation measurement"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r2 --slot 36 --why "Candidate two still holds meaningful support against candidate one, slot thirty six gives the best available separation for that pair among the earliest reachable options"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30231-r2 --slot 38 --why "Final budgeted observation targets the last live pair one versus two at its best remaining separation to push the leading candidate past the resolution threshold"

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-30231-r2 --why "Candidate one, period thirteen point six days, reached support point nine nine nine after eliminating candidates three and four early and progressively separating from candidate two with confirming observations, well above the resolution threshold"

content.text:
Campaign complete and resolved.

- **Selected candidate:** index 1, period ≈ 13.60672 days
- **Final support:** 0.999362 (theta = 0.997)
- **Observations used:** 6/6

Three further observations at slots with near-maximal separation progressively drove candidate 1's support from ~0.85 to ~0.999, comfortably clearing the resolution threshold.
